name: 가시사마귀
appearance: Tall jade mantis with thorn-shaped forearms folded in a threatening martial pose, narrow angular head and segmented abdomen.

motions.stand: Facing left, move the two antennae independently, subtly turn the narrow head and flex the folded thorn forearms, abdomen expands then settles, loop back to the threatening original guard.
motions.move: Facing left, quick insect stepping cycle in place with alternating planted legs and a pitched segmented abdomen, thorn forearms remain folded near the face while antennae react to each step.
motions.attack1: Facing left, draw both thorn forearms high and back in a clear wind-up, lean forward and sweep the scythe forearms down and forward together toward the left, hold the long extended strike briefly, retract to the original guard. No beams.
motions.hit1: Facing left, recoil the angular head and abdomen to the right, arms spread defensively and supporting legs bend, recover to the folded martial guard.
motions.die1: Facing left, forearms uncurl and sag, long supporting legs buckle and the mantis tips onto its side, abdomen settles and antennae lower, finish lying motionless.
